/*
================================================================================
项目名称 : 小新台湾 (Crayon Shin-chan TW) CBT 测试首周报告
模块编号 : 04 - 付费 SKU 归一化与首购/复购承接路径对比 (TW CBT vs SG CBT/OBT)
数据表   : 
  - 小新繁体 CBT: ta.v_event_18 (AppID 18)
  - 小新新加坡  : ta.v_event_13 (AppID 13)
归一化规则 :
  - 提取 product_id / sku_id 后缀，合并不同平台/渠道 (Apple / Google / Huawei) 原始 SKU
================================================================================
*/

WITH ScanConfig AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_start_date,
        DATE '2026-07-29' AS tw_end_date
),

-- 1. 小新繁体 CBT 充值日志 (归一化 SKU)
TW_Recharge AS (
    SELECT
        '1.小新繁体CBT' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.product_id'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.sku_id'),
            'unknown_product'
        ) AS raw_product_id,
        CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE) / COALESCE(s5.exchange, 1) AS amount,
        e."#event_time" AS pay_time
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange s5
      ON e."$part_date" = s5.ex_date
     AND e.pay_currency = s5.currency
    CROSS JOIN ScanConfig sc
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(sc.tw_start_date AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(sc.tw_end_date AS VARCHAR)
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),

-- 2. 小新新加坡 CBT 充值日志 (归一化 SKU)
SG_Recharge AS (
    SELECT
        '2.小新新加坡OBT1' AS cohort_name,
        e."#user_id" AS user_id,
        COALESCE(
            CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.product_id'),
            JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR(CAST(e.payload AS JSON), '$.sku_id'),
            'unknown_product'
        ) AS raw_product_id,
        CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
        e."#event_time" AS pay_time
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    WHERE e."$part_date" BETWEEN '2026-05-08' AND '2026-05-14'
      AND e."$part_event" = 'charge'
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox = FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy = FALSE)
),

CombinedRecharge AS (
    SELECT * FROM TW_Recharge
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM SG_Recharge
),

NormalizedRecharge AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_name,
        user_id,
        raw_product_id,
        -- SKU 归一化逻辑：去除平台前缀 (e.g. com.dena.shinchan.tw.product1 -> product1)
        CASE
            WHEN POSITION('.' IN raw_product_id) > 0 THEN ELEMENT_AT(SPLIT(raw_product_id, '.'), -1)
            ELSE raw_product_id
        END AS normalized_product_id,
        COALESCE(amount, 0.0) AS amount,
        pay_time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_name, user_id ORDER BY pay_time ASC) AS pay_seq
    FROM CombinedRecharge
)

SELECT
    cohort_name AS "对比组",
    normalized_product_id AS "归一化商品ID",
    COUNT(1) AS "购买次数",
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS "购买人数",
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN pay_seq = 1 THEN user_id END) AS "首购人数",
    ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS "贡献流水($)",
    ROUND(SUM(amount) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_name), 2) AS "流水占比(%)"
FROM NormalizedRecharge
GROUP BY cohort_name, normalized_product_id
ORDER BY "对比组", "贡献流水($)" DESC
